search_text: 不定积分 $\int\frac1{3x^2+3x-1}\,dx$ 的值为 $\frac1{\sqrt{21}}\ln\left|\frac{\sqrt3(2x+1)-\sqrt7}{\sqrt3(x+1)+\sqrt7}\right|+C$ $\frac1{\sqrt{21}}\ln\left|\frac{\sqrt3(2x+1)-\sqrt7}{(2x+1)+\sqrt7}\right|+C$ $\frac1{\sqrt{21}}\ln\left|\frac{\sqrt3(2x+1)-\sqrt7}{\sqrt3(2x+1)+\sqrt7}\right|+C$ $\frac1{\sqrt{21}}\ln\left|\frac{\sqrt3(x+1)-\sqrt7}{(2x+1)-\sqrt7}\right|+C$ 配方并用凑微分法，原积分化为对数式。
